basics.name: Riku Hiltula
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer and Architect, Partner
basics.summary:
Riku is a technically savvy senior software engineer and architect with insight into how to develop elegant and maintainable systems out of complex domains.

He has a strong engineering background, enjoys the problem-solving aspect of software design, and excels as part of an agile team in full stack web development. He’s also enthusiastic about learning new technologies and has a talent for quickly picking up new ones.

Lately he has been developing services that utilize various AI capabilities that run the mill of vector databases, genAI, RAG, multimodal models and OCR.
basics.x-tagline: Good engineering means solving the problems that create genuine value and help the business grow.

x-strengths.title: Backend development
x-strengths.description: Riku has an extensive experience of developing RESTful backend services in Node.js and Python.

x-strengths.title: Frontend development
x-strengths.description: Riku has a vast experience of frontend development with many frameworks like React, NextJS, Angular and others as well as with SPA and SSR.

x-strengths.title: Cloud platforms & container orchestration
x-strengths.description: Riku has utilized both AWS and GCP using many different services and is also a very capable user of Kubernetes.

x-keyRoles.title: System designer
x-keyRoles.description: Riku has been in multiple projects where he has made decisions on how to design the new system from scratch. As such he has lots of insights on how to make that happen successfully. Thinking in systems gives Riku a perspective on development that guarantees a robust solution.

x-keyRoles.title: Developing eCommerce
x-keyRoles.description: Ecommerce development lends itself very well into other business domains. Having developed things like user auth, file storage, database indexing, APM, search, serverless, geocoding, observability and many others make Riku a very versatile fullstack developer.

x-keySkills.title: Generative AI
x-keySkills.description: Riku has lately been focusing on developing systems that use generative AI, RAG, multimodal models and OCR. This experience has given Riku new ideas on how to think outside of the discrete coding box.

work.name: Kipinä Software Oy
work.position: Senior Software Engineer and Architect, Partner

work.name: Kettu Software Oy
work.position: Fullstack Developer, Backend Developer, Frontend Developer

projects.name: Citation and contradiction checker PoC for a TV show
projects.description: Riku created a proof of concept of an API and an app that was able to generate 100 % correct citations and a contradictions checker. This was achieved by using a multimodal LLM model by OpenAI. A script readiness checker based on highlight colors was also explored.

projects.name: Generative AI pipeline for sustainability data
projects.description: The client develops a system that scrapes public sustainability and corporate responsibility related data and generates various things with generative AI including sustainability acts, goals and company profiles. Riku's role was to design and implement the generation pipeline which was done by creating a queue of generation jobs which then start generation steps like scraping, classifying, generation and post processing.
keywords: GCP (Vertex AI, Cloud Run, SQL Postgres, Storage, Translate)

projects.name: AI Assistant
projects.description: Riku developed a service where a user can upload files which are stored in a vector database which is then used to do a Retrieval Augmented Generation with a chat bot interface. This allows the user to ask questions about the material in natural language. He designed the system to be able to be scoped by customer so that the chat bots could be hosted securely behind customer auth.

projects.name: Ad automation and orchestration libraries
projects.description: Riku's task was to take the shared automation and orchestration libraries for ads, ad sets and campaigns into use with two social media platforms. He also developed a shared video template render queuing library to be used by all platform teams. The work done with frontend, ASTs and directed acyclic graphs drove a measurable profit increase.

projects.name: CRM backend
projects.description: Riku was tasked with investigating the legacy system, planning the new system, creating tickets out of the plans and doing the work for what was to become a CRM for the company. He created the REST API endpoints with Serverless Express, designed the data model and database indexes etc.

projects.name: Product system frontend update
projects.description: Riku's task was to update the codebase to the new designs, add new features, and to integrate over 30 new products to the existing system. He also wrote some utility scripts that used ffmpeg to expedite image manipulations.

projects.name: Ad management core service rebuild
projects.x-note: Source date '01/2023-08/2022' is reversed; corrected to 08/2022–01/2023.
projects.description: Riku was responsible for a major rebuilding of the core service that automates ad, ad set, and campaign management for a social media platform. The project was executed in close partnership with the platform and featured a very ambitious deadline. The project was fully delivered within the agreed upon schedule.

projects.name: Backend for a delivery service self-trial
projects.description: Riku was tasked with the design and creation of a new backend system that linked the new UI of the client's delivery service product to the product's microservice API and existing company services. The objective of this system was to allow potential new customers to test the service and even use it without undertaking potentially costly API integration work of their own.

projects.name: Self-service portal backend
projects.description: Riku was responsible for taking sole ownership of the backend that managed the self-service functions and email communication to users for the portal with 500 000+ MAU. He implemented numerous improvements to the codebase, which resulted in better maintainability, observability and architecture.

projects.name: Reporting database integration
projects.description: Riku was tasked with developing the backend integration to a Microsoft SQL Server database used to store Power BI reports. As the task was straightforward and completed promptly, he moved on to other responsibilities in the project.

projects.name: Brand website rewrite
projects.description: Riku was tasked with rewriting most of the existing codebase for the client's brand website as the new designs were vastly superior to the old ones and most of the time the existing code didn't fit well with them. He and a colleague were praised for their swift work pace and quality.

projects.name: Waste management product ordering
projects.description: Riku was responsible for adding ten new features or fixes in ten days. Added IE11 support, fixed a bunch of bugs and added more features related to ordering of waste management products.

projects.name: Digital law office app
projects.description: Riku was responsible for working on the digital law office's app that featured anonymous user interactions in order to protect the privacy of its users. He improved the login flow, made the NextJS app a PWA and among other things, reverse-engineered Typeform enough to drop their SDK that was too sluggish to run on older mobile devices. The startup got off the ground.

projects.name: Service backend and CI/CD
projects.description: Riku was responsible for the backend side of the service, created CI / CD pipelines, the REST API, user authentication with AWS Cognito, user messaging with Sendgrid, S3 Antivirus for file uploads and a cron job for cleaning the database. He also delivered some of the frontend features like the admin view.

projects.name: E-commerce web shop platform
projects.description: Riku was part of the work that became a general-purpose e-commerce web shop platform. During the two years he worked on most parts of the system including user auth, admin portal, pdf preflight, SQS, antivirus for the pdfs, S3, etc. He acquired a huge amount of know-how on modern web programming.
keywords: AWS (S3, Cognito, Cloudfront, Lambda, SES, SQS)

projects.name: Browser clone of a legacy Java application
projects.description: Riku was tasked with creating a clone from a 20-year-old Java application that would run in the browser. He used this project for his Bachelor's thesis on building a modern web application. The app featured a responsive design – a feature the old app did not have.
